name: codex-usage-insights
description: Analyze local Codex session logs and render an auditable HTML usage dashboard.

interface.shortDescription: Analyze Codex usage and build animated reports.
interface.longDescription: A local-first Codex skill that scans session JSONL files, matches explicit skill mentions, summarizes activity by project and day, and renders a portable HTML dashboard with JSON data. It ignores system and tool records and never publishes local logs.
defaultPrompt: Analyze my recent Codex usage and generate an HTML report.
Show which Codex skills I used in the last 30 days.
Find installed skills with no observed usage in a selected date range.
